subscription_plans.description: Full feature access for individual users.
Full feature access plus dedicated account management for organizations.

refund_policy.notes: Refunds are calculated on the unused portion of the current billing cycle, rounded to 2 decimal places, and never exceed the monthly fee or fall below zero.

retention_offers.description: 20% off the next 3 months for Premium subscribers.
A dedicated account manager will review usage and pricing with the customer.
One additional month of service at no charge for customers within their first 30 days.
Pause billing for 30 days so the customer can return when they have a clearer need.
Escalate the issue to priority support and keep the subscription active while it is investigated.
Review the competing option and see whether a discount or plan adjustment can match the customer's needs.

cancellation_rules.notes: Retention offers must always be presented before a cancellation can proceed. Cancellation only proceeds once the customer explicitly declines the offer.

grace_period.notes: Customers may reactivate a cancelled account within 7 days without losing historical data.
